May 31, 2018 - By Henry Gaston
Lehman Financial Resources Inc decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 40.71% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Lehman Financial Resources Inc sold 3,680 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.37% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 5,359 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $899,000, down from 9,039 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Lehman Financial Resources Inc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $921.00 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.06% or $0.12 during the last trading session, reaching $187.38. About 15.96 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% since May 31, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.99% the S&P500.
Sky Investment Group Llc increased its stake in Dominion Resources Inc. (D) by 218.4% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC.
